datasets.title: Satellite detected water extents in Punjab Province, Pakistan as of 27 & 28 August 2025
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FL20250818PAK, GDACS ID: 1103435 This map illustrates the satellite detected water extent in Punjab Province, Pakistan as observed from a Sentinel-1 satellite image acquired on 27-28 August 2025. Within the analyzed area of approximately 88,300 km², about 3,660 km² of land appears to be affected by floodwaters. Based on WorldPop population data and the flood extent, approximately 2.5 million people are potentially exposed or living close to the flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Important note: Flood analysis from radar images may underestimate the presence of standing waters in built-up areas and densely vegetated areas due to the backscattering properties of the radar signal.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-water-extents-in-punjab-province-pakistan-as-of-27-28-august-2025]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: Sentinel-1 SAR satellite imagery from 27-28 August 2025 was analyzed by UNOSAT to detect water extent through comparison of pre- and post-event images, identifying notable changes in surface water. The resulting flood extent polygon (3,660 km²) was intersected with WorldPop gridded population data to estimate approximately 2.5 million people potentially exposed to floodwaters in Punjab Province.
